tasks.spec: Act as an independent, read-only governance auditor. Do not modify Paperclip, Beads, git, services, credentials, OAuth state, Herdr, listeners, or any host configuration. Read only ../snapshot.json, a sanitized live Paperclip snapshot captured immediately before this run. Write exactly one substantive Markdown file named luna-quarantine-audit.md in your current task directory. Evaluate whether the Luna recovery quarantine is presently safe and whether it is terminally complete. Required invariants: Luna High Planner must remain provider=copilot and model=gpt-5.6-luna; JAC-3592, JAC-3593, JAC-3594, and JAC-3595 must each remain blocked, unassigned, and have executionRunId=null; stale recovery lanes JAC-3622, JAC-3608, JAC-3617, and JAC-3603 must not be able to replay openrouter or openai-codex; JAC-3626 is the active Wings-owned quarantine action and JAC-3609 is the human Copilot OAuth gate. Distinguish snapshot facts from inference. Treat any todo/in-progress stale recovery lane or active Wings run as a reason not to declare terminal completion. Include sections titled Snapshot Provenance, Invariant Matrix, Stale Lane Analysis, Active Run Analysis, Fail-Closed Decision, and Exact Next Gate. State one explicit governance verdict: SAFE_HOLD, UNSAFE, or TERMINAL_PASS. A task-level PASS means only that this audit was produced and executable checks passed; it must not be phrased as implementation authorization. Cite exact issue identifiers, statuses, assignees, executionRunId values, Luna adapter fields, and snapshot timestamps. End with READ_ONLY.
tasks.check:
set -eu; f=luna-quarantine-audit.md; if [ ! -s "$f" ]; then echo 'FAIL: luna-quarantine-audit.md missing or empty' >&2; exit 1; fi; for term in 'Snapshot Provenance' 'Invariant Matrix' 'Stale Lane Analysis' 'Active Run Analysis' 'Fail-Closed Decision' 'Exact Next Gate' 'SAFE_HOLD' 'READ_ONLY'; do if ! grep -Fq -- "$term" "$f"; then printf 'FAIL: audit missing required phrase: %s
' "$term" >&2; exit 1; fi; done; bytes=$(wc -c < "$f" | tr -d ' '); if [ "$bytes" -lt 3500 ]; then printf 'FAIL: audit too small: %s bytes
' "$bytes" >&2; exit 1; fi; python3 -c 'import json; d=json.load(open("../snapshot.json")); by={x["identifier"]:x for x in d["issues"]}; a=d["agents"][0]; assert a["adapterConfig"]["provider"]=="copilot", "Luna provider drift"; assert a["adapterConfig"]["model"]=="gpt-5.6-luna", "Luna model drift"; assert all(by[i]["status"]=="blocked" and by[i]["assigneeAgentId"] is None and by[i]["executionRunId"] is None for i in ("JAC-3592","JAC-3593","JAC-3594","JAC-3595")), "implementation quarantine invariant failed"; assert by["JAC-3626"]["status"]=="in_progress" and by["JAC-3626"]["executionRunId"] is not None, "expected active Wings quarantine run absent"; assert by["JAC-3622"]["status"]=="todo", "expected stale todo lane absent"; print("SNAPSHOT_CHECK=PASS exact policy preserved; implementation lanes quarantined; terminal completion correctly held")'; printf 'EXECUTED_CHECK=PASS luna-quarantine-audit bytes=%s
' "$bytes"
tasks.verified: The audit proves the captured exact Luna policy and four implementation quarantine invariants while fail-closing terminal completion on the active Wings run and stale todo lane.
